method_note: Health = share of the 10 MomentumScore target ranges met; trade-based checks only when the report carries a trade log, otherwise the score is met/available out of the curve checks. Curve checks here run on each report's own downsampled chart series (<=1500 points) - close, not bit-exact; report 93's engine computes its own exact card on full-resolution data. Robustness = beats the benchmark in BOTH halves of the (common) window. Tax = capital-gains estimate, 23 Jul 2024 regime + cess + set-off.
